verdict.rationale: Asana documents official client libraries for JavaScript and Python. It also provides a v3 Node SDK migration guide covering pagination and states that the SDK picks up new endpoints soon after release. A published OpenAPI spec backs these SDKs. Missing for 10: official SDKs beyond JavaScript and Python, detail on the Python SDK itself, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: The official libraries available are listed below: JavaScript, Python
The v3 Node SDK supports the `nextPage` method for pagination
This means you can take advantage of the latest features and endpoints through the Node SDK soon after their release.
